name: Whisper
description: Robust speech recognition model supporting 99 languages.
longDescription: Whisper is an automatic speech recognition (ASR) system trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual data. It approaches human-level robustness and accuracy on English speech recognition and supports transcription and translation across 99 languages.

codeSnippets.label: Python
codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI()
audio_file = open("audio.mp3", "rb")
transcription = client.audio.transcriptions.create(
    model="whisper-1",
    file=audio_file
)
print(transcription.text)
